name: 34957 · Jensen Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 34957 (Jensen Beach) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34957 (Jensen Beach) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34957 (Jensen Beach) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
